about: LAND-A2 R8 §3 (26 Sep 2026): the arrival guard reads a file's week from its content, never its path. These pupil-sheet pages carry the Week 1 arrival line but print no week, and no week-stating page links them, so their week cannot be read. Each leaves this list when it prints its week. The list only shrinks: check_arrival_surfaces.py fails on an entry that is no longer served, no longer carries the line, or has a readable week, and on any entry outside the ruled set.
